the eight source relation kinds are source-space (equivalence, linkage, overlap, pooling, estimand composition, backfill, provenance, alias); none orders time

summary.headline: Every temporal meaning has a lawful jurisdiction and a lawful authority HOME, and none has a competent positive AUTHORITY in place. Five are recoverable as conserved function (authority material debt). Two need a bounded positive form (the temporal relation and the temporal comparability/directionality authority). One needs no form at all (trajectory). No meaning requires a new architecture.
